title: Real World Cross-AI Collaboration Pipeline
description: Human-governed workflow for task execution, artifact exchange, independent review, correction, and evidence-backed verification across independent AI systems.

verification.scope: Specification publication and readback; no complete end-to-end multi-provider execution or automated integration test.

evidence.claim: The RWCAI-13 specification is present in the canonical SYSBLOG main branch.
evidence.notes: Confirms specification publication only; does not prove automated dispatch, API integration, shared memory, or a completed end-to-end multi-provider task.

limitations: Automated cross-provider dispatch is not verified.
Shared cross-provider memory is not implemented by this documentation.
A complete task ledger with independent AI output, handoff, review, correction, and acceptance evidence remains to be recorded.
